units.source_text: 光阴荏苒，这小公子年龄越长，相貌越是美好，竟使见者吃惊。

en.t: As time passed, the young gentleman grew ever older and ever more handsome, astonishing everyone who saw him.

units.source_text: 那件“伤心旧事”，确已完全忘却了。

en.t: That sad old affair had indeed been completely forgotten.

units.source_text: 源氏想道：“想是前生注定要诞生这个人，所以发生那件意外之事吧。

en.t: Genji thought, Perhaps it was destined in a former life that this person should be born, and that was why that unexpected event occurred.

units.source_text: 命运真是无可逃避的啊！”

en.t: Fate truly is impossible to escape.

units.source_text: 他的想法已经有些改变。

en.t: His feelings had already changed somewhat.

units.source_text: 他想想自己的命运，觉得也有许多不能称心的事情：

en.t: When he reflected on his own fate, he felt that many things in it had not gone as he wished.

units.source_text: 许多妻妾之中，只有这位三公主身份毫无缺陷，品貌也可满意，却想不到会做了尼姑。

en.t: Among his many wives and consorts, only this Third Princess had a completely unblemished rank and satisfactory beauty and character, yet he had never imagined she would become a nun.

units.source_text: 如此看来，她和柏木的罪过还是不可原宥，真乃遗憾之事。

en.t: Seen in this light, her sin and Kashiwagi's still could not be forgiven, and it was truly a matter for regret.
